Recompose these familiar materials into a fresh, coherent castle vignette never seen in the book: view from just inside a side arch, at a low child's eye level, looking DIAGONALLY along the hall into depth. Large cropped pearl arch frames upper left and side; the familiar brush lies diagonally on a low marble ledge in near foreground at lower left, making an inviting visual entry. No new room theme, no new story event, no additional characters, no Daddy, no transformation, no rainbow Puff, no nap, no soap-cloud climax. Gentle intrigue, sunlit welcoming atmosphere, consistent soft contact shadows and painterly materials. NOT a collage of panels, not a reused interior frame, no extreme wide-angle distortion. Leave upper-middle pale lavender wall/soft daylight area clean and quiet for TWO future lines of back-cover copy; do NOT render text, letters, logo, border or watermark. Preserve the supplied character/material designs while changing their composition and camera relationship. No 3D-render look, no pixel art.
